translations.literal: He composed books on geography and miscellaneous biographies, which appeared only after his death.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote books on geography and miscellaneous biographies, which appeared only after his death.

sentences.zh: 澄弟鮮，得罪宋世，當死。

translations.literal: Cheng's younger brother Xian offended in Song times and was to be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng's younger brother Xian offended during the Song and was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 澄於路見舍人王道隆，叩頭流血，以此見原。

translations.literal: Cheng met Attendant Within the Yellow Gates Wang Daolong on the road and knocked his head until it bled; on this account he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng met Attendant Within the Yellow Gates Wang Daolong on the road and knocked his head until it bled; on this account Xian was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 揚州主簿顧測以兩奴就鮮質錢，鮮死，子暉誣爲賣券，澄爲中丞，測與書相往反，後又牋與太守蕭緬云：「澄欲遂子弟之非，未近義方之訓，此趨販所不爲，況搢紳領袖，儒宗勝達乎？

translations.literal: Gu Ce, Chief Clerk of Yangzhou, pledged two slaves with Xian for money. When Xian died, his son Hui falsely claimed they had been sold on contract. Cheng was Imperial Censor; Ce exchanged letters back and forth with him, and later also sent a note to Grand Administrator Xiao Mian saying: "Cheng wishes to indulge his younger kinsmen's wrongdoing and does not approach the teaching of righteous conduct—this is what peddlers would not do, how much less a leader of the gentry and an eminent master of Confucian learning?"
translations.idiomatic: Gu Ce, Chief Clerk of Yangzhou, pledged two slaves with Xian for a loan. When Xian died, his son Hui falsely claimed they had been sold outright. Cheng, as Imperial Censor, exchanged letters with Ce, who later also wrote to Grand Administrator Xiao Mian: "Cheng wishes to indulge his kinsmen's wrongdoing and shows no regard for righteous teaching—this is what peddlers would not do, how much less a leader of the gentry and an eminent Confucian scholar?"

sentences.zh: 」測遂爲澄所排抑，世以此少之。

translations.literal: " Ce was then suppressed by Cheng, and the world on this account thought less of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: " Ce was then suppressed by Cheng, and the world thought less of Cheng on this account.

sentences.zh: 時東海王摛，亦史學博聞，歷尚書左丞。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Chi of Donghai was also broad in historical learning and had served as Left Assistant in the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wang Chi of Donghai was also renowned for historical learning and had served as Left Assistant in the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 竟陵王子良校試諸學士，唯摛問無不對。

translations.literal: The Prince of Jingling, Xiao Ziliang, examined and tested the various scholars; only Chi answered every question without fail.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Jingling, Xiao Ziliang, examined the various scholars; only Chi answered every question correctly.

sentences.zh: 永明中，天忽黃色照地，衆莫能解。

translations.literal: During Yongming the sky suddenly turned yellow and illuminated the earth; none could explain it.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongming era the sky suddenly turned yellow and illuminated the earth; no one could explain it.

sentences.zh: 摛云是榮光。

translations.literal: Chi said it was glorious radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Chi said it was auspicious radiance.

sentences.zh: 世祖大悅，用爲永陽郡。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu was greatly pleased and employed him in Yongyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu was greatly pleased and appointed him to Yongyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 史評

translations.literal: Historiographer's Appraisal
translations.idiomatic: Historiographer's Appraisal

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：儒風在世，立人之正道；

translations.literal: The historiographer says: When the Confucian wind is in the world, it establishes the correct Way for men;
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: When the Confucian tradition flourishes in the world, it establishes the correct Way for humanity;

sentences.zh: 聖哲微言，百代之通訓。

translations.literal: the subtle words of sages and wise men are the universal instruction for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: the subtle words of sages are the universal teaching for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 洙泗旣往，義乖七十；

translations.literal: When Zhu and Si had passed, the meaning diverged among the seventy;
translations.idiomatic: After the age of Zhu and Si, the meaning diverged among the seventy disciples;

sentences.zh: 稷下橫論，屈服千人。

translations.literal: at Jixia they debated across the land and made a thousand men submit.
translations.idiomatic: at Jixia they debated freely and humbled a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 自後專門之學興，命氏之儒起，石渠朋黨之事，白虎同異之說，《六經》五典，各信師言，嗣守章句，期乎勿失。

translations.literal: Afterward specialized learning arose and lineage-named Confucians appeared; the factional affairs of Stone Canal and the differing opinions of White Tiger—the Six Classics and Five Canons, each trusting its master's words, inheriting and guarding the clauses and sentences, hoping not to lose them.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward specialized schools arose and lineage-named scholars appeared; the factional disputes of Stone Canal and the differing opinions of White Tiger—the Six Classics and Five Canons, each trusting its master's words, inheriting and guarding the commentarial clauses, hoping not to lose them.

sentences.zh: 西京儒士，莫有獨擅；

translations.literal: Among the Confucians of the Western Capital, none monopolized learning alone;
translations.idiomatic: Among the Confucians of the Western Capital, none monopolized learning;

sentences.zh: 東都學術，鄭賈先行。

translations.literal: in the Eastern Capital scholarship, Zheng and Jia led the way.
translations.idiomatic: in the Eastern Capital, Zheng and Jia led scholarly learning.

sentences.zh: 康成生炎漢之季，訓義優洽，一世孔門，褒成竝軌，故老以爲前脩，後生未之敢異。

translations.literal: Kangcheng was born at the end of blazing Han; his instruction and meaning were ample and harmonious, the Confucian gate of a whole age. Bao and Cheng walked the same track; the old considered him a former exemplar, and the young did not dare differ from him.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan was born at the end of Han; his teaching was ample and harmonious, the Confucian school of an entire age. Bao and Cheng walked the same path; elders regarded him as a former exemplar, and the young did not dare dissent.

sentences.zh: 而王肅依經辯理，與碩相非，爰興《聖證》，據用《家語》，外戚之尊，多行晉代。

translations.literal: Yet Wang Su argued from the classics and opposed the great master; he thereupon produced Holy Evidence and relied on the Family Sayings. The honor of maternal kin was largely practiced in Jin times.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Wang Su argued from the classics and opposed the great master; he produced Holy Evidence and relied on the Family Sayings. The honoring of maternal kin was largely practiced in Jin times.

sentences.zh: 江左儒門，參差互出，雖於時不絕，而罕復專家。

translations.literal: The Confucian gate east of the Yangtze emerged unevenly and in succession; although it did not cease in its time, specialists rarely appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian learning east of the Yangtze emerged unevenly; though it never entirely ceased, specialists rarely appeared again.

sentences.zh: 晉世以玄言方道，宋氏以文章閒業，服膺典藝，斯風不純，二代以來，爲教衰矣。

translations.literal: The Jin age took abstruse discourse as the Way; the Song house took literary composition as a sideline occupation. Devotion to the canonical arts was impure in this wind; since those two eras, teaching has declined.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took abstruse discourse as the Way; the Song took literary composition as a sideline. Devotion to the canonical arts grew impure; since those two dynasties, learning has declined.

sentences.zh: 建元肇運，戎警未夷，天子少爲諸生，端拱以思儒業，載戢干戈，遽詔庠序。

translations.literal: When Jianyuan first received the mandate, military alarms were not yet pacified; the Son of Heaven in youth had been a student and sat upright in contemplation of Confucian learning; weapons were laid aside and an edict hastily ordered the schools.
translations.idiomatic: When Jianyuan first received the mandate, military alarms were not yet pacified; the emperor had been a student in his youth and sat in contemplation of Confucian learning; weapons were laid aside and schools were hastily ordered established.

sentences.zh: 永明纂襲，克隆均校，王儉爲輔，長於經禮，朝廷仰其風，冑子觀其則，由是家尋孔教，人誦儒書，執卷欣欣，此焉彌盛。

translations.literal: Yongming succeeded and continued, multiplying the schools and balancing instruction; Wang Jian served as assistant, excelling in the classics and ritual. The court looked up to his wind; the students observed his rule. Thereupon households sought Confucian teaching and men recited Confucian books; holding their scrolls with joy, here it flourished all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongming the succession continued, schools multiplied and instruction was balanced; Wang Jian served as chief minister, excelling in the classics and ritual. The court looked up to his example; students followed his standard. Thereupon households sought Confucian teaching and men recited Confucian books; holding their scrolls with delight, learning flourished here all the more.

sentences.zh: 建武繼立，因循舊緒，時不好文，輔相無術，學校雖設，前軌難追。

translations.literal: Jianwu succeeded to the throne and followed the old course; the age did not favor learning, the chief ministers had no method, and though schools were established, the former track was hard to recover.
translations.idiomatic: When Jianwu succeeded he followed the old course; the age did not favor learning, the chief ministers lacked effective policy, and though schools were established, the former standard was hard to recover.

sentences.zh: 劉瓛承馬、鄭之後，一時學徒以爲師範。

translations.literal: Liu Huan inherited after Ma and Zheng; the students of the age took him as their model.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huan stood in the tradition of Ma and Zheng; the students of the age took him as their model.

sentences.zh: 虎門初辟，法駕親臨，待問無五更之禮，充庭闕蒲輪之御，身終下秩，道義空存，斯故進賢之責也。

translations.literal: When the Tiger Gate was first opened, the imperial carriage came in person; there was no five-geng ritual for awaiting inquiry, and the courtyard lacked the carriage with rush wheels. He ended his life in low rank while the Way and righteousness remained empty—this is the responsibility of advancing the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tiger Gate was first opened, the imperial carriage came in person; there was no five-geng ritual for awaiting inquiry, and no carriage with rush wheels filled the courtyard. He ended his life in low rank while his moral authority remained unhonored—such is the court's failure to advance the worthy.

sentences.zh: 其餘儒學之士，多在卑位，或隱世辭榮者，別見他篇云。

translations.literal: The remaining Confucian scholars were mostly in humble positions; those who hid from the world and declined glory are treated separately in other chapters.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining Confucian scholars mostly held humble positions; those who withdrew from the world and declined glory are treated in other chapters.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：儒宗義肆，紛綸子珪。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Confucian patriarch, righteousness spread abroad—Zigui wove it all together.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: A patriarch of Confucian learning, righteousness spread abroad—Zigui wove it all together.

sentences.zh: 升堂受業，事越關西。

translations.literal: Ascending the hall to receive instruction, his affairs surpassed those west of the Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Students ascended his hall to receive instruction; his renown surpassed the masters west of the Pass.

sentences.zh: 璡居闇室，立操無攜。

translations.literal: Jin dwelt in a dark chamber and established conduct without deviation.
translations.idiomatic: Jin dwelt in modest seclusion and maintained conduct without compromise.

sentences.zh: 彥淵書史，疑問窮稽。

translations.literal: Yanyuan in books and history exhausted inquiry into every doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Yanyuan in books and history pursued every question to the end.

sentences.zh: 〈「徐令上文」疑。〉

translations.idiomatic: Editorial note: The passage "Magistrate Xu's text above" is doubtful.
